title: experiment.evaluation_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator instructs EvaluatorAgent to evaluate the frozen RunRecord against the frozen BenchmarkSpec under the frozen VerifierSpec's protocol (EvaluatingExperiment state, state machine V1.10). EvaluatorAgent's EvaluatingExperiment mode is M12 -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

run_record_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen RunRecord object to be evaluated.

verifier_spec_ref.description: Optional frozen VerifierSpec ref; null when evaluation is grounded by the reproduced baseline and BenchmarkSpec.

benchmark_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen BenchmarkSpec object the run is evaluated against.

baseline_result_ref.description: Optional ref to the already accepted frozen BaselineResult. It supplies the authoritative baseline-side conditions for comparison auditing.

research_memory_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the prior ResearchMemory to ground the evaluation in, or null if none exists yet.

spec_interpretation_ref.description: Optional SpecInterpretation carrying a survey validation study.
